fail_conditions: More than three ETFs have directional_consistency_60 < 0.40

equity_dominance.note: Stage-A medians have 11/13 equity constituents; pooled event shares are descriptive, never performance-tuned weights.

limitations: Short regimes censor forward windows; insufficient-transition regimes are diagnostic only.
Neighbour timing differences cover +/-3-bar matched events only; low matching coverage precludes interpreting them as global lag.
Regimes are retrospectively date-defined stress segments, not prospective regime labels.
No production detector is built regardless of verdict.

protocol.aggregation: Rates pooled from integer eligible/event counts; MFE/MAE pooled event medians; duration pooled directional-run median. Also report unweighted symbol medians.
protocol.decision_scope: Regime pooled event rates; full-period per-symbol rates; full-period pooled baseline minus delay-3 directional_consistency_60.
protocol.delay_semantics: Original observation at i-delay is attached to current daily bar i; unavailable prefix stays None. Prices and date axis never move.
protocol.event_windows: Existing evaluate_metrics semantics, clipped at the relevant scope end; no crossing regime/split ends. Audit includes full-period and regime-clipped outcomes.
protocol.major_regime_valid_transitions: At least 20 transitions with complete 60 observed-bar forward windows within that regime, pooled across the fixed 13 ETFs.
protocol.missing_values: Undefined remains null; no imputation; unavailable required decision rates prevent PASS. Regimes below 20 valid transitions are descriptive only.
protocol.neighbour_matching: Existing ascending-A nearest-unused-B +/-3 observed-bar matching; A is lexical first candidate, earlier B breaks ties; absolute timing differences in observed trading bars, matched events only.
